attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It says the bishopric is unknown and cites the Jerusalem Kanonarion, p. 96, for the memory, so he is told from the corpus's other Martyrii by the day alone and the slug carries it; none of them is kept on 25 June in any calendar. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
